query:
UPDATE dictionary_items
               SET label = COALESCE($1, label),
                   value = COALESCE($2, value),
                   sort = COALESCE($3, sort),
                   status = COALESCE($4, status),
                   is_default = COALESCE($5, is_default),
                   remark = COALESCE($6, remark),
                   updated_at = NOW()
               WHERE id = $7
